name: mobilenet_frozen_128_control
train: same Frozen protocol; size-matched representation control
freeze_strategy: entire backbone frozen/eval; projection and classifier trainable
normalization: ImageNet mean/std inside graph; external RGB float32 0..1
augmentation: flip, rotation8degrees, color jitter .12/.12/.1; frozen caches 4 augmented +1 original view
selection: ID val accuracy then ID CE loss, no OOD/test use
projection_init: PCA128, fit only ID train then trainable
